messages:
maya: Tiny update - we quietly crossed 2k ARR this morning. not flashy but thrilled :tada:
trent: omg congrats!!!! :confetti_ball:
lia: this calls for ice cream. who’s in for mini-sundaes at 4pm? :ice_cream:
sam: in. can we get dairy-free? lia please ping the cafe
evan: i’ll bring spoons and a tiny bell for the 'ring the milestone' ritual
ops-bot: Backup checkpoint completed: no errors. Reminder: add milestone to metrics dashboard.
maya: remote folks - we’ll mail sticker packs and a "milestone playlist" link after the party
lia: can someone draft a one-liner for the weekly all-hands? suggestion: "2k ARR milestone: quiet hustle, mini-sundaes, and steady ops." tweak away
trent: love it. +1 to "quiet hustle"
sam: poll: mini-sundae flavors? choc / vanilla / mango. vote with emoji
maya: :chocolate_bar:
trent: :tropical_drink:
evan: :vanilla_ice_cream:
maya: cake or sundaes for 5k next quarter? :wink:
all: see you at 4pm!
